Fed & Policy Watch
  • Fed Governor Christopher J. Waller has a scheduled 3:45 AM ET discussion today; the classifier marks this unmatched name provisional Medium. Beige Book is scheduled Wednesday afternoon.
  • The Board's October calendar says daily and weekly statistical releases scheduled for Columbus Day shift to Tuesday, Oct 13. Individual H-series and other statistical releases are not listed here unless an exact date and time were confirmed from a date-specific source.
  • TreasuryDirect confirms Tuesday bill supply: $95B 13-week and $82B 26-week competitive cutoffs at 11:30 AM, plus $95B 6-week at 1:00 PM. These are bill auctions, not coupon auctions.
  • The Thursday 8:30 AM cluster includes Census retail sales, Chicago Fed NFCI, and the Philadelphia Fed survey. EIA's petroleum report is shifted to noon Thursday for Columbus Day.
Omissions and Watch
  • BLS was excluded by operator decision dated Oct 11, 2026; no BLS site or mirror was requested. BLS releases, including CPI, PPI, and import/export prices, are not verified or shown in this calendar.
  • Date-specific primary-source checks: Federal Reserve Board, BEA, Census, TreasuryDirect, EIA, NY Fed, Chicago Fed, Philadelphia Fed, NAR, NYSE, and SIFMA. BEA's checked schedule returned December entries, not a date-specific Oct 13-16 event. This calendar is selected and limited to verified exact times.
  • Fed statistical-release pages/calendar did not provide a complete date-specific lineup and exact times for H.10, H.15, Commercial Paper, and H.4.1 during this check. The Commercial Paper page says postings are usually daily at 1:00 PM but gives no guarantee; that general timing was not treated as a verified event. No such rows are inferred.
  • NY Fed Empire State survey lists Oct 15 and says release is "at or shortly after 8:30"; exact time is not specified, so it is omitted. EIA natural-gas schedule gives a usual Thursday time but no date-specific Oct 15 listing, so it is omitted rather than inferred. Later Treasury bill auction records had no confirmed competitive cutoff times at this cutoff and are omitted.
  • Beige Book timing check: Chicago Fed's dated release calendar lists Oct 14 at 3:00 PM ET. The prior published briefing stated 2:00 PM ET as a Board time, but the Board's checked October calendar did not substantiate that time; this update uses the dated Chicago Fed calendar and flags the discrepancy.
  • SIFMA lists Columbus Day, Oct 12, as a U.S. fixed-income market holiday; that session is elapsed. MOVE and official Treasury yield data remain dated Oct 9. No verified unscheduled geopolitical or policy watch item from this run; this is not a claim that no such risks exist.
  • Yahoo quotes are single-source. ES=F and other futures quotes are generic vendor quotes, not official settlement values; verify live contract, depth, and hours before execution.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Treat the 8:20 PM ET ES quote as overnight context, not a cash-session confirmation. MOVE remains in the moderate band, while the latest 10Y close is elevated at 5.24%. Respect today's Waller discussion, housing release, and bill supply; Thursday's 8:30 AM data cluster and EIA report are the main verified catalysts ahead. Scenario framework only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess the scenario if ES sustains a range break with confirmation from live Treasury yields, volatility, and market depth, or if the applicable contract's trading hours differ. No unsupported levels or price targets are supplied; reconfirm live quotes before execution.
